parsed_response.rationale: All documented independent functional outcomes for the actors are covered by the current high-level goals. The 'Ensure timely ambulance response' goal addresses the Dispatcher's responsibility to allocate an available ambulance within 11 minutes. The 'Maintain accurate dispatch data' goal covers the Radio Operator's role in recording precise departure and destination information. The 'Enable real-time location tracking' goal aligns with the Ambulance Driver's task of following standard routes and communicating their position accurately. Lastly, the 'Support rapid emergency initiation' goal supports the Emergency Caller's ability to quickly report incidents. No independently missing high-level outcomes were found.
